answer: Proof-of-location multilateration resists Sybil attacks by having distributed verifiers time round-trip responses to a signed signal to anchor each agent to unique coordinates. Because waves cannot outrun light, running extra agents across a canyon or a lotus pond forces an attacker to fund separate radios and links per identity. However, multipath scattering and clock jitter require loose distance tolerances, letting co-located devices share one apparent zone.
